candidates.title: LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
candidates.abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.
candidates.reason: 対象。長文脈LLM推論・学習で用いるDeepSeek Sparse Attentionの索引計算とKVアクセスを対象に、階層的な疎選択、層間の索引再利用、連続領域を使う注意機構を組み合わせて効率化する研究である。本文の推論レイテンシ評価と品質比較を確認した。
candidates.library_body_check: 一次資料HTMLのSection 2.3では、DSAの索引器が長文脈ほど支配的になり1024K時に層レイテンシの90%を占めること、非連続なKV gatherが実効HBM帯域を約4.5%に落とすことをTable 1とともに確認。Section 3ではStreaming-Aware Indexing (SI) がattention budgetの一部をsink/local windowへ割り当て連続アクセスを増やすこと、Cross-Layer Indexing (CLI) が隣接層グループで索引を共有しdistillationで品質を補うこと、Hierarchical Indexing (HI) がpage単位のcoarse-to-fine選択でTop-K負荷を抑えることを確認。Section 4.1のTable 2/3はBF16、K=2048等の条件下でattention kernelおよびfull-layerのprefill/decode latencyを比較し、Section 4.2ではattention layer学習の1.53x (32K)～1.61x (1024K) speedup、Section 4.3/Figure 5ではLongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) のend-to-end prefill 1.42x～3.60x、decode 1.25x～1.40x speedupを報告。HIのTable 4ではprefill 32K～128Kで0.79x～0.82xと遅く、1024Kで4.11xとなるため約200K超で有効化すると説明。Section 5.1～5.2/Table 6～8はLongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) とLongCat-Flash (560B-A27B) を比較し、HELMET長文脈平均がLiteでLSA 59.02、MLA 58.50、DSA 58.60、FlashでLSA 64.43、MLA 62.70、また一般・推論・coding指標は概ね同等と報告。Section 6/Table 15はLite-SparseのHI有効化で長文脈品質が概ね近い一方、LongCodeQAが62.30から59.37へ下がる例を示す。Section 7の明示的限界はLSAが総KV-cache footprintを削減せず、KV partition/offloadingもaggregate storage overheadを下げない点。以上からLLM推論効率化に直接該当するためaccept。

candidates.title: SoftWater: Class-Aware Rate Allocation for Softmax Quantization
candidates.abstract: Post-training quantization pipelines routinely leave the softmax output layer in high precision. Yet in small LLMs with modern vocabularies, the head holds 15--30\% of all parameters, so a nominal ``2-bit''model with an fp16 head can store several times as many bits per weight. We pose softmax-layer quantization as a rate-distortion problem under the KL divergence between the original and quantized output distributions. A second-order analysis reveals a class-aware geometry: quantization error is weighted jointly by feature covariance and class-specific softmax curvature. A separability approximation replaces the $Kn\times Kn$ Cholesky with one $n\times n$ factorization rescaled per class, making the lattice encodable by successive interference cancellation, with both statistics from a single forward pass. The resulting method, SoftWater, gives fine grids to frequent, low-variance classes and coarse grids to rare ones, a large gap under Zipfian token distributions. Across five models from 1B to 32B, SoftWater outperforms the released WaterSIC quantizer (near-optimal under linear-layer WMSE but not output KL) at matched head rates on 59 of 60 test points, using none of that pipeline's refinements and cutting head-induced KL by $6.5\times$--$8.3\times$ at 2 bits. On Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct with quantized bodies, a 2-bit head removes 45--60\% of stored bytes for a $2.9$--$3.7\%$ perplexity increase. Because the class-side statistic comes from calibration data, matching calibration to the deployment domain gives the lowest KL on that domain throughout. On a tied model, a 4-bit head is near-lossless and a 2-bit head costs under 4\% perplexity, making head quantization of such models practical.
candidates.reason: SoftWaterは、LLMの出力softmax重みを出力分布のKL歪みに基づいて低bit量子化し、語彙クラスごとの頻度・曲率と入力特徴共分散に応じて率を配分するPTQ手法である。§5.1の5モデル（1B–32B）評価では、同一ヘッド率のWaterSICに対して60点中59点でKLが小さく、2-bit時のWikiText2 head-induced KLを6.5–8.3倍抑えた。Llama-3.2-1B-Instructでは2-bit headにより保存bytesを45–60%減らし、WT2 perplexity増加は2.9–3.7%。推論モデルの重み・出力層の圧縮を扱うため対象内とする。主な限界は分離近似が一般には保証されず、測定したモデルで誤差最大10%であること、および量子化済みbodyを使った全モデル実験が単一系列に限られること。
candidates.library_body_check: 一次資料 arXiv HTML（v1、2026-08-12）を確認。§1と§3でfp16のまま残されるsoftmax headが小型LLMのparameter/memory負担となる問題と、目的を E[KL(p||q)] とする設定を確認。§4.1–4.4では二次近似からクラス別softmax曲率 λ̄_k と入力共分散 Σ_X を用い、クラスk・特徴列iの格子幅を λ̃_k^-1/2 |ℓ_ii|^-1 に比例させる方法、同一calibration forward passから統計を得る手順、SIC符号化、未観測クラスへのε=0.1 smoothingを確認。§5.1 Table 2では5モデルのhead-only比較を行い、WikiText2の128×1024 tokenでcalibrateしWT2/C4のPPLとKLを評価、同じhead rateのWaterSICと60条件中59条件で比較勝ち、2-bit WT2 KLを6.5–8.3倍低減（C4では3.5–5.1倍）と報告。§5.2–5.4/Table 3–5では量子化body併用、ドメイン別calibration、ARC-Easy/ARC-Challenge/HellaSwag/LAMBADA/WinoGrande/PIQA/OpenBookQAのzero-shot結果を確認。§5.6/Table 6は分離proxyがWT2/C4で真の歪みを最大10%過小評価し、率ペナルティ最大0.07 bitと報告。§6の限界は、分離近似に一般保証がなく、全モデル実験が単一familyの公開quantized bodyに依存する点。学習効率化の論文ではなく、推論用重み圧縮に該当する。

candidates.title: Pre-Compiled Pipeline Shards for Distributed LLM Inference on Intel AI PC Fleets
candidates.abstract: Modern Intel AI PCs ship capable integrated GPUs and NPUs with 16+ GB of unified memory, and they spend considerable time idle. That is not enough memory to fit a large model such as a 70B-parameter LLM. We show that a handful of AIPCs, working together over an ordinary network, can serve models beyond the capability of any single one. We use pipeline parallelism: a model is split by layer into per-stage shards, each pre-compiled into an OpenVINO graph, so that every machine runs one shard and passes activations to the next. Three techniques make this fast enough to be useful. First, we recover the speed of the unsplit model: a naive per-stage export runs well below monolithic inference because it misses an OpenVINO GPU optimization, and injecting a beam_idx Gather into each shard triggers that optimization (the IndirectKVCache fusion) and brings the shards to parity. Second, we leverage speculative decoding on stateful OpenVINO models. Third, the pipeline serves several users at once by interleaving their requests across the stages, each request carrying its own cache (micro-batching). Together, a two-node Llama 3.1 8B INT4 pipeline serves two concurrent users at 1.79x the single-user throughput of the unsplit model on the same hardware, and the gap widens under simulated wide-area latency. The same design scales to a 70B model that no single fleet member can hold: a four-node deployment of Lunar Lake AI PCs on Intel Tiber Cloud serves a single user at interactive speed, with output token-for-token identical to the same four-node pipeline decoding without speculation. Code, raw benchmark logs, and reproduction scripts ship as a self-contained package at https://github.com/labscommunity/pipeline-sharded-inference-paper (in the top-level reproduction/ directory).
candidates.reason: Intel AI PC群で単体機のメモリに収まらないLLMを推論するため、層単位に分割したOpenVINO shardを複数ノードで実行し、推論時投機的デコードと複数利用者のmicro-batchingを組み合わせる研究である。Llama 3.1 8Bの同一ハードウェア比較で単体baselineを上回る複数利用者throughputを示し、70Bの4ノード推論も評価しているため、LLM serving・推論効率化に該当する。評価は主にIntel統合GPUとOpenVINOに限られ、他社GPU環境との比較は行っていない。
candidates.library_body_check: arXiv v1本文の§3.1–3.4で、HuggingFace checkpointから連続層ごとのINT4 OpenVINO IR shardを事前生成し、各段がKV stateを持ってactivationをTCP relayする構成を確認。§4とTable 2ではLlama 3.1 8B INT4をArc B390 iGPU、OpenVINO 2026.1.0で比較し、beam_idx Gather注入により単体exportの21.26 tok/sから24.45 tok/sへ改善、monolithic 24.54 tok/sとの差を0.4%以内にしたと報告する。§5.1–5.3では物理KV trimが約48 msかかる問題に対し、attention_maskで棄却draft位置を無効化するrewind方式を提示し、物理trimとのlogits差0.0000、K=3での追加CPU費用がstep時間の1%未満とする一方、cacheは生成中に膨張し、長いmulti-turn向けの生成中compactionは未実装・未測定と明記。§6.1–6.3およびTable 7では3台のIntel AI PC上の2-node Llama 3.1 8B INT4を評価し、2 stream micro-batchingとK=3 speculative decodingの合成で43.97 tok/s、同じ単体monolithic基準の1.79倍を報告する。§6.11とTable 17ではIntel Tiber Cloud上の4-node Llama 3.1 70B INT4がtarget-only 1.74からK=10で5.42 tok/sとなり、同一topologyのgreedy出力との一致を最初の10 tokenで確認するが、monolithic 70B外部参照はexport時RAM不足で未取得。§8.7の限界は信頼できるネットワークを仮定し、fault tolerance・authentication・encryptionがなく、全nodeで同じsoftware stackを要すること、評価対象が統合GPU中心であること。異種GPU比較をしていない旨は§2.1に記載。対象はIntel/OpenVINO fleet上の分散LLM推論であり、一般GPUクラスタにおける優位性までは示していない。
